title: The sealed door
starting_code:
# Pick up the wand first
# Then cast zelim beside the door
hints: Move to the wand and pick it up. Do this before going to the door.
Stand next to the sealed door before you cast the spell.
Use the `cast` method with "zelim" to break the seal. Then walk through.
intro: I set the wand down to show you something. A spell needs a wand. Pick it up and cast zelim at the sealed door.
outro: The seal broke! The wand makes your words into magic.
learned: Now you know that a spell is a string cast with a wand.
